title: Felsted School
description: Felsted School campus, Essex, England — a 90-acre independent school founded in 1564.  2 km × 2 km world at 2 m terrain resolution.  Road geometry, buildings, and water from OpenStreetMap; terrain from Environment Agency LiDAR Composite DTM 2 m (River Chelmer valley 40 m → campus 76 m → surrounding ridge 77 m).
roads: OSM: B1008, Stebbing Road, campus roads, service
features: Environment Agency LiDAR 2 m terrain, OSM game elements (speed limits, bridges), campus buildings, sports fields
